neighbours.label: comparison with all earlier times: 'bigger than ever / than last year', 'has never been more / better' (the - pole is 'for the first time')
fire: Ticket sales for the fair are higher than ever before.
The garden looks better this spring than it did last year.
It has never been easier to start a small online shop.
Our harvest was larger than in any previous season.
The museum is busier now than at any time in its history.
Interest in chess has never been greater among teenagers.
This year's parade was longer than last year's.
Prices at the market are lower than they have been in a decade.
quiet: Ticket sales for the fair begin on the first of June.
The garden looks lovely in the spring with all the tulips.
It is quite easy to start a small online shop with a laptop.
Our harvest was gathered by hand over three weeks.
The museum is busy on weekends with school groups.
Interest in chess is growing among teenagers.
This year's parade started at the town hall.
Prices at the market are posted on a board by the door.

notes: Probe: 'bigger than last year' 0.65 at ' than', 'never been a better moment' 0.23.
